semantics: Coarse family correspondence, not a learned semantic classifier. Each class is scored independently against ALL predictions from its mapped families, without consulting ground truth to select predictions. Shared-family classes therefore share predictions and may have low precision. Only defining faces count; bottom labels and constituent faces do not expand predictions. Identical face sets across mapped families are one prediction. Stock is not covered: polygonal_stock describes a body, not residual unmachined faces.

classes.name: rectangular_passage
classes.rationale: An enclosed rectangular through cut. Rust publishes principal rectangles as section_passages and non-principal rectangles as oriented_slots; independent OpenCascade aligned and rotated box-minus-prism constructions verify both representations.

classes.name: triangular_through_slot
classes.not_covered: V-section through channel; Rust slots require opposed parallel walls.

classes.name: rectangular_through_slot
classes.rationale: The generator extrudes a rectangle anchored to one stock edge through the stock normal. Along that through axis the remaining boundary is a U-section: two opposed walls and a floor, open at both ends. This is Rust channels, not the enclosed passage/slot interpretation. Verified with an independent OpenCascade box-minus-prism construction.

classes.name: circular_through_slot
classes.not_covered: Circular-section open through channel; Rust channels require a rectangular floor and walls.

classes.name: Oring
classes.not_covered: Annular blind recess cut in a planar stock face; Rust grooves describe turned external shaft bands.

classes.name: v_circular_end_blind_slot
classes.rationale: Open U-section with a semicircular bottom; mapped to the round-bottom slot family even where its stricter flat-bottom/quarter-cylinder implementation cannot recognise it.

classes.name: h_circular_end_blind_slot
classes.rationale: Open U-section with two quarter-circle corners and a flat between them, extruded to a blind cap.

classes.name: triangular_blind_step
classes.rationale: Triangular sketch anchored to two stock edges, cut blind: an oblique corner face and triangular terminal.

classes.name: rectangular_blind_step
classes.rationale: Rectangular sketch anchored to two stock edges, cut blind: a corner notch (pockets edge_anchored).

classes.name: stock
classes.not_covered: Residual stock faces have no recognition family.
